finalText:
Migration's done. 12 files across billing, orders, support, accounts, catalog, and analytics still called `db.query` — they're all switched to `db.execute({ sql, params })` now.

Two things stayed put on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query`, since that's vendored code you'd overwrite on the next upgrade anyway, and `cache.query` calls were left alone — different method, just a similar name.

The repo's own check script confirms it: `OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved`.
